provenance.canvas: native css var --bg (#040806) lifted into graphify's own green family (~luma 29) to clear the frame-brightness floor and the operator's standing 'every video seems dark' note
provenance.accent: native css var --accent (#22c55e, hue 142) lifted ~30 luma to #4ade80 (same 142 hue, graphify green) so the flash inverted field clears the readability spread floor and reads genuinely bright
provenance.hairline: derived mix(ink, canvas) at the lifted canvas

readability.notes: Dark green canvas (~luma 29). Hero/body text ships as --ink (#e6f5ec, ~242 luma) so p99.3 clears 180. Accent-scale TEXT uses the renderer's --accent-ink (accent lifted to ~205); raw #4ade80 stays on dots, edges, glow, and the flash field. Muted content lines use --muted-content; raw --ink-muted only for decorative tags.
bright_beats: scene 5 diagram: the lit green path is the frame's light source (the ANSWER)
scene 6 flash: full-bleed bright green field (#4ade80 ~luma 167), inverted polarity measured on its own
readability.brightness_plan: Canvas lifted off near-black plus a green aurora lift plus one full bright-green flash field targets overall mean luma >= 46; the flash and the lit path are the two designed brightness beats (color-script, not one dark wash).

color_gate_note: accent hue 142 (green) sits 125 off 07-07 violet (267) and 106 off 07-08 amber (36), both >= 60, with ΔE00 far past 11; canvas stays dark. Passes variety_check color gate on hue+ΔE00.
